component.name: knotra
component.summary: See and update all your Git and Jujutsu projects in one place
Git と Jujutsu のプロジェクトをまとめて確認・更新

description.p: knotra is a desktop dashboard for people who work across many Git and Jujutsu (jj) repositories at once.

Instead of opening a terminal in each project to check its state, knotra shows every repository in your workspace on one screen and groups them by what needs your attention: projects that need help, unsaved work, available updates, local commits not yet shared, and decisions waiting for you.

From there you can act on many repositories together, with the care that bulk changes need. "Get latest safely" only fast-forwards, so it never creates a merge commit, and it never merges over unsaved work: those repositories are only checked for updates, unless you choose to save the work, get the latest and restore it afterwards. "Save release point" tags a release across the projects you choose, checks each of them first, and rolls back if any step fails. History keeps a per-project record of every operation, so you can see what happened and why. When changes conflict, "Choose resolution" guides you through the choice, and "Generate notes" drafts release notes from your recent commits.

knotra is local-first. It has no accounts, no telemetry and no advertising, and it never sends your data anywhere. It works through the Git and Jujutsu already installed on your computer, so your existing settings and credentials keep working as they are.

knotra is available in English and Japanese. It is built to be easy on the eyes: large, clear text, a colour and a symbol for every status, zoom up to 150 %, light and dark themes and two high-contrast themes, and keyboard shortcuts for common actions. It is free and open source software, licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
